gold_insights.insight: “由粗到精”位姿估计整体流程：前端以 SuperPoint+SuperGlue 在 3DGS 稀疏渲染参考图库中检索相似度最高的参考图像 I_GS 并给出初始六自由度位姿；随后用 EPnP（将 3D 点线性组合为 4 个虚拟控制点）求解精确相对位姿；再以 ICP（点到平面距离最小化）对齐源/目标点云；接着执行 BA（联合优化相机位姿与空间点，最小化重投影误差）；最后进行基于 3DGS 的单尺度迭代渲染-配准优化，更新位姿，收敛阈值为位姿变化 <1 cm 或 <0.1°，最多迭代 10 次。
gold_insights.source: 基于3D高斯溅射的大规模场景重定位方法_张守建.pdf

gold_insights.insight: 关键误差控制手段：迭代阶段采用 Huber 鲁棒核降低异常匹配点影响，并对输入图像的动态物体与遮挡区域进行剔除；地图构建联合优化图像损失（L1 与 SSIM，动态区加权放大为 5，λ_r=0.2）、深度一致性（与 LiDAR 逆深度对齐，λ_depth=0.1）、不透明度约束（包含天空掩膜项，λ_opacity=0.05）与多种正则化项；渲染合成采用 C=C_G+(1−O_G)C_sky 的不透明度融合以降低伪影。
gold_insights.source: 基于3D高斯溅射的大规模场景重定位方法_张守建.pdf

gold_insights.insight: 前端匹配稳定性与由粗到精的迭代增益：SuperPoint+SuperGlue 在大场景中的特征点分布率约 70%，显著优于 ORB+BFMatcher 的约 40%；迭代渲染提升匹配质量（匹配点数从 58→126→257→383，平均置信度从 0.735→0.826→0.892→0.957，分布均匀性从 0.354→0.466→0.598→0.701），在参考图库稀疏渲染导致视角差异较大时，仍能通过逐步视角逼近提升相对位姿求解精度。
gold_insights.source: 基于3D高斯溅射的大规模场景重定位方法_张守建.pdf

gold_insights.insight: 地图构建与实时性、精度表现：基于相机、IMU、Velodyne HDL-64E S2 LiDAR 与场景 MASK 的多传感器融合，采用 OmniRe 动态城市重建框架，将节点划分为背景（G_b）、刚性（G_v）、SMPL 人体与可变形节点，并以优化后的天空纹理独立渲染再与 O_G 融合；系统使用 Python/PyTorch 与自定义 CUDA 光栅化/反传核加速微渲染，每帧处理约 1 s；在 KITTI 城镇道路、林荫道路、高速公路中，平均定位精度分别为 0.026 m、0.029 m、0.081 m，绝对轨迹 RMSE 分别约 0.026 m、0.027 m、0.079 m，且 96% 帧的平移/旋转误差小于 10 cm/1°；高速公路较差源于特征退化与匹配分布不均，但总体仍满足实时性与厘米级定位。
gold_insights.source: 基于3D高斯溅射的大规模场景重定位方法_张守建.pdf

gold_insights.insight: The coarse-to-fine relocalization pipeline consists of: (1) retrieving the nearest anchor image from a database; (2) estimating the relative pose via PnP; (3) rendering a new anchor image with the 3D Gaussian model; and (4) iteratively updating the pose until convergence, which typically occurs after ~5 iterations. Time profiling shows per-call costs of SuperPoint ~10 ms, SuperGlue ~30 ms, PnP ~2 ms, and rendering ~6 ms, with execution counts of ~25 (feature extraction/matching) and ~5 (PnP/rendering), yielding total relocalization times of 1.04–1.84 s across scenes. Retrieval time increases linearly with anchor set size, so reducing the query database via anchor selection is key to maintaining real-time performance.
gold_insights.source: 基于3D高斯溅射的大规模场景重定位方法_张守建.pdf

gold_insights.insight: Error control is implemented via a loss comprising a color reconstruction term, a geometric sparsity term, and an uncertainty regularization term, and by removing dynamic/occluded regions using semantic segmentation and depth-consistency checks to ensure geometric consistency and rendering stability. Under the success criterion of <10 cm translation and <1° rotation error, the method achieves the highest success rates across KITTI, Waymo, and nuScenes; on KITTI, it attains 2.92 cm/0.67° and 3.51 cm/0.71° in typical sequences.
gold_insights.source: 基于3D高斯溅射的大规模场景重定位方法_张守建.pdf

gold_insights.insight: Ablation results show that iterative optimization and deep feature matching (SuperGlue) contribute most to accuracy and stability: removing SuperGlue degrades robustness under weak texture or significant illumination changes (more mismatches and higher errors), and omitting iterative optimization prevents convergence when the initial pose is biased, increasing both translation and rotation errors. The complete model achieves the best mean errors of 3.22 cm and 0.69° across urban and open-road scenes, while disabling dynamic-occlusion handling notably harms performance in urban traffic.
gold_insights.source: 基于3D高斯溅射的大规模场景重定位方法_张守建.pdf

gold_insights.insight: The 3DGS map is built via a self-developed pipeline with an average of ~1.5×10^6 Gaussian points per frame, and initialization employs joint optimization of depth consistency and camera pose to achieve global alignment, outperforming five baselines. However, single-direction KITTI data introduce a limited high-fidelity renderable view range; large angular deviations during iteration degrade rendering quality and hinder convergence accuracy. This highlights the need for multi-view data acquisition, good pose initialization, and techniques to reduce sensitivity to angle errors when extending to large-scale, free-view scenarios.
gold_insights.source: 基于3D高斯溅射的大规模场景重定位方法_张守建.pdf
